ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the lines AB and CD intersect at point O, with OM $\perp$ AB, and ON $\perp$ CD. If $\angle 1 = \frac{1}{3}\angle BOC$, find the degree measure of $\angle BOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given: $\because \angle 1 = \frac{1}{3} \angle BOC$,\\
$\therefore \angle BOM = 2\angle 1 = 90^\circ$,\\
We find: $\angle 1 = 45^\circ$,\\
$\therefore \angle BOD = 90^\circ - 45^\circ = \boxed{45^\circ}$.
